figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
FIG. 1. Proposed biosynthetic pathway of oxytetracycline (1) in S. rimosus. The biosynthetic pathway was established previously by Hunter and
coworkers based on an exhaustive analysis of shunt products. The assignments of the tailoring enzymes are based on their functions obtained
through protein-protein BLAST analysis. We conﬁrmed in this report the role of OxyD and the minimal PKS in the biosynthesis of an amidated
decaketide. We also conﬁrmed the role of OxyJ as the C-9 ketoreductase.
